summary: This directory provides the execution logic and testing harness for generating summaries from files. It focuses on the operational layer required to process, compute, and validate file summary data within the pipeline infrastructure.
responsibilities: Provide test suites for file processing operations
relationships: The executor runs the logic required to produce file summaries within the pipeline.
Tests verify that the execution of file summary tasks conforms to expected outputs.
designDecisions: Encapsulated execution logic separated from pipeline definition
Dedicated test directory for validation of core pipeline operations
